name: UI：淘内资源池-自然语言搜索框验证
description: 验证淘内资源池存在自然语言描述搜索框，placeholder提示示例

steps.expression: return (() => { const inputs = document.querySelectorAll('input'); const nlpInput = Array.from(inputs).find(i => i.placeholder?.includes('自然语言') || i.placeholder?.includes('描述搜索')); return { found: !!nlpInput, placeholder: nlpInput?.placeholder || null }; })()

steps.description: 验证 验证自然语言搜索 存在

steps.expression: return (() => { const inputs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input[type=text], input:not([type])')).filter(i => i.offsetParent !== null); if (inputs.length === 0) return { filled: false }; const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(inputs[0], 'test_input_001'); inputs[0].dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles:true})); inputs[0].dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles:true})); return { filled: true, value: inputs[0].value }; })()
